description: Average Monthly Household Electricity Consumption by URA Region& Dwelling Type, 2011 (series on data.gov.sg) is a series of datasets listed in Singapore open data portal (data.gov.sg), an open data portal, published or maintained by Energy Market Authority. Show average monthly electricity consumption by URA planning area and dwelling type (in kWh). Coverage: Singapore. The portal lists 5 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher Energy Market Authority. It offers 1 resource(s) in geojson. The portal shows 2026-06-24 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-sg-dgs-portal.
